players.product: AI servers and high-end computers: scaleX640 single-cabinet 640-card supernode, scaleX40 cable-free box supernode and scaleX supercluster; HPC systems; ParaStor / FlashNexus storage; immersion and cold-plate liquid cooling

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): operating revenue RMB 14,963,644,356.95, up 13.81%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 2,176,292,865.25, up 13.87%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 1,837,698,173.45, up 33.97%; operating cash flow RMB 1,313,355,634.49, down 51.75%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 2,586,233,304.50, Q2 RMB 3,263,727,712.84, Q3 RMB 2,970,259,205.60, Q4 RMB 6,143,424,134.01; quarterly net profit attributable: Q1 RMB 186,472,838.24, Q2 RMB 542,187,978.29, Q3 RMB 237,452,752.11, Q4 RMB 1,210,179,296.61. The company attributes the profit growth to a better product mix and good returns from its stakes along the chain, including Hygon Information Technology, Zhongke Xingtu and Sugon Shuchuang.

FY2025 revenue mix (annual report): IT equipment RMB 12,503,495,716.44, up 6.81%, gross margin 27.31%; software development, system integration and technical services RMB 2,446,417,235.70, up 75.34%, gross margin 47.25% (up 3.53 points), driven by strong growth in data-center, cloud and custom development services. By customer type: public sector RMB 7,713,220,855.36 (+7.79%, gross margin 35.06%), enterprise RMB 7,236,692,096.78 (+21.72%, gross margin 25.79%). Overseas revenue RMB 3,240,850.35; direct sales RMB 14,268,258,225.85, distributor sales RMB 681,654,726.29.

FY2025 volumes (annual report): IT equipment complete machines produced 228,413 units (down 15.71%), sold 238,959 units (down 9.98%), inventory 35,629 units (down 22.84%). Production is mainly in-house with outsourced production as a supplement; sales are mainly direct.

Top five customers (annual report) were RMB 1,235,347.29 ten-thousand, 82.56% of 2025 sales; related-party sales among them RMB 69,545.56 ten-thousand, 4.65% of sales. Two of the five are new customers: customer 1 RMB 289,701.33 ten-thousand (19.36%) and customer 2 RMB 69,293.29 ten-thousand (4.63%); names not disclosed.
quarterly_data.figure: top five customers 82.56% of 2025 sales; new customer 1 19.36%

quarterly_data.signal: Top five suppliers (annual report) were RMB 188,565.73 ten-thousand, 19.19% of 2025 purchases; related-party purchases among them RMB 32,497.83 ten-thousand, 3.31%. One new supplier among the five: supplier 1 RMB 39,450.77 ten-thousand (4.01%); names not disclosed.

Supernode status (annual report): Sugon launched the single-cabinet supernode scaleX640 and, built on the 640-card supernode, the scaleX ten-thousand-card supercluster, an open AI computing architecture supporting multi-brand accelerator cards and compatible with CUDA and other mainstream software ecosystems; in February 2026 the scaleX supercluster went live at the National Supercomputing Internet core node. The company states that its supernode and supercluster products have not yet achieved large-scale market deployment and that it will push their commercialization. It also says the country's first thirty-thousand-card-class domestic AI compute pool went into operation in 2025.

2026 business plan and outlook (annual report): the company plans to focus investment on AI compute, next-generation liquid cooling and high-speed interconnect, and to strengthen adaptation of domestic chips, operating systems and databases for supply-chain security. In its outlook it says that, affected by the external environment, capital spending by domestic internet majors and carriers is shifting significantly toward domestic compute chips and servers.

Liquid cooling and power (annual report): subsidiary Sugon Shuchuang released the C7000-F phase-change cold-plate liquid-cooling solution in June 2025 (cooling capacity up more than 15%, temperature down more than 5 degrees C) with its own SFP-1025F refrigerant; it began overseas expansion from Southeast Asia, set up a wholly owned subsidiary in Singapore and landed overseas projects; its 400V HVDC power supply system raised rated power by 26% and power density by 49.50%. Products cover C8000 immersion and C7000 cold-plate liquid-cooling infrastructure and modular data centers.
quarterly_data.figure: C7000-F +15% cooling capacity; 400V HVDC power density +49.50%

quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): FY2025 R&D investment RMB 1,638,936,753.05, all expensed, 10.95% of revenue; 3,199 R&D staff (53.10% of employees); cumulative R&D over the last three years RMB 53.34 hundred million.

Sugon.why: Chinese high-end computer and AI server maker (scaleX640 supernode, scaleX supercluster); IT equipment is most of its revenue, so its stock rises with AI server and data-center CPU platform demand.
Sugon.evidence: Sugon annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-15-2026): IT equipment revenue RMB 12,503,495,716.44 of RMB 14,963,644,356.95; launched the single-cabinet supernode scaleX640 and the scaleX supercluster.
